metadata.description:
Integration with Wikimedia Commons for uploading survey-related images.
Features inspired by the Wikimedia Commons mobile app: - Upload photos to Commons directly from surveys - Categorize photos automatically based on location and title - Configure default licenses for uploaded content - Require consent for public uploads
For more information about Wikimedia Commons, visit: https://commons-app.github.io/
